about: The digest is SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical form. Law order, rule order, layout, comments and the Unicode form of strings do not change it; any change to a rule does.
laws:
laws "conformance" version 1

law a-reads
  says  "Café readers may read."
  why   "Conformance."
  on    action read of Doc
  permit when principal in Group::"admins"
  forbid when context.amount > 100
  evidence watched

law b-code
  says  "Code law."
  why   "Conformance."
  on    code "src/**/*.rs", "lib/*.rs"
  evidence tested by command "make laws"
